tests.name: pre_fix_target_with_shutdown_probe
tests.observation: TestClient shutdown cancelled Worker during MCP Client.__aexit__; Worker acknowledged cancellation and worker.release ran. Isolated run did not hang.

tests.name: post_fix_target_with_shutdown_probe
tests.observation: MCP client exit and Assistant return occur before TestClient shutdown; Worker is at empty poll when shutdown cancellation is requested.

root_cause.confirmed: The test treated terminal Domain Run status as Worker dispatch completion and closed TestClient while MCP Client cleanup remained in progress.
root_cause.fix: The test now waits for _dispatch_run completion and next_worker_run returning no pending work before leaving TestClient.
root_cause.historical_full_suite_hang_exclusive_cau: strongly supported, not separately captured as a stuck asyncio task

raw_logs: Private raw logs preserved locally; hashes and local path are in runs/LOG_INDEX.txt.
